text:
anna (People Ops): quick idea 30 run a surprise desk-side 'Kudos Cookies' drop the Friday before the performance cycle close. cookies + tiny 'kudos' sticker on each pack. purpose: low-effort thank-you and gentle reminder to submit peer spot-award nominations. thoughts?

bryce (Events): love it. can we do a gluten-free & vegan option? also propose a tiny insert with a QR to the nomination form.

mei (Facilities): logistics: we'll need a packing table in the mailroom and 3 volunteers per 100 packs to distribute across HQ. for satellite offices, we can do packaged kits shipped to office managers.

jorge (Vendor Relations): vendor options: bakerlane.co (local artisanal, same-day for 300 within city) or cookiecrate.net (nationwide, bulk price). pricing estimates: bakerlane $3.50/pack (small runs), cookiecrate $2.10/pack (bulk). stickers + insert add ~$0.35/pack.

anna (People Ops): target qty = 250 HQ, 120 EU offices, 30 APAC = 400 total. estimate budget using cookiecrate: (400 * ($2.10 + $0.35)) = $940 + shipping. request $1100 to be safe.

zoe (Volunteer): volunteer note: we should recruit 8 packers and 6 desk-runners. running a signup in #volunteers. can Ops cover pizza for pack night? :yum:

ops-bot: reminder scheduled  collect dietary prefs CSV and finalize PO by 1981237000.

mei (Facilities): dietary collection plan: I'll post a short form where people can opt-out or register allergies. but we won't collect per-person for surprise drop; we'll reserve ~15% GF/vegan packs for general distribution.

jorge (Vendor Relations): PO draft for review:
```
vendor: cookiecrate.net
item: 'Kudos Cookie' pack (2 cookies + sticker + insert)
qty: 400
unit_price: $2.45 (includes sticker/insert)
packaging: eco kraft bag
shipping: estimated $120
lead_time: 7 business days
```

bryce (Events): insert copy suggestion: "Thanks for the great work this cycle. Nominate a peer for a Tiny Triumph at <short.link/nominate>" keep it brief. avoid mentioning monetary awards (legal asks).

anna (People Ops): approved. finance: allocate $1100 from culture events budget?

zoe (Volunteer): recruiting note: I'll post a GCal event for packing night (Thursday 6-8pm) and a distribution rota for Friday. packers will get early access to sample cookies.

mei (Facilities): distribution plan: HQ desk drops 9-11am Friday. EU shipments to office leads arrive Thursday and distributed Friday morning. APAC kits to be couriered as manager bundles with instructions.

ops-bot: reminder sent  vendor quote expires 1981237600. finalize PO before then to lock pricing.

anna (People Ops): checklist: 1) finalize vendor & PO (jorge) 2) create insert + QR (bryce) 3) volunteer signups (zoe) 4) packing table reservation (mei) 5) confirm budget (finance). I'll update when PO is sent. thanks all :cookie:
